_comment: Metric C2 for packages/core. Stryker 10 is installed outside the repo and its @stryker-mutator directory is symlinked into the measurement worktree's root node_modules so the plugin resolves from cwd. Run from packages/core with vitest.stryker.config.ts copied next to vitest.config.ts: STRYKER_TEST_INCLUDE='src/core/llm-chat.test.ts,<direct importers>' node <strykerInstall>/node_modules/@stryker-mutator/core/bin/stryker.js run <this file> --mutate 'src/core/llm-chat.ts' --inPlace. In-place mode drops the executable bit on some files when it restores; run git checkout -- packages/core afterwards. The mutate list is passed per experiment; the milestone sample is a fixed list stored next to the results.
